Cisco ME 2600X Series Ethernet Access Switches were created for the delivery of today's and tomorrow's access services. They support existing and next-generation features and technology while remaining operationally simple to deploy and manage. The series offers the following key benefits:
A 100-Gbps power-efficient application-specific integrated circuit (ASIC) to power switches
Service-aware quality of service (QoS), helping service providers expand and differentiate their residential services
Industry-leading technology to lower power foot print to less than 2.5 Watts per Gigabit Ethernet with optic

text.text: The Cisco ® ME 2600X Series Ethernet Access Switches are the latest members of the ME family of switches built specifically for Fiber to the Home (FTTH) and Fiber to the Building (FTTB) services.
